basic_details.job_title: SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in
basic_details.short_information: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Trivandrum, an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, will hold a walk-in interview on 4 December 2026 at 10:30 am, with reporting at 09:30 am, at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS Building, SCTIMST, Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram. The interview is for 1 temporary post of Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) on a foreign funded diabetes research project, with monthly emoluments of Rs. 1,20,000/- (Consolidated). content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST
content_sections.text: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology is located at Thiruvananthapuram - 695 011, Kerala, and describes itself as an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. This notice was issued by its Research & Publication Cell for the foreign funded project "The long-term effectiveness of a peer-led lifestyle intervention program on diabetes progression and cardiovascular risk: The Kerala Diabetes prevention program in India" (P-5393).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one existing vacancy for Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) (Temporary). The essential qualification and experience, as printed in the notice, are: MD Community Medicine/ MD in Ophthalmology/MD in General Medicine Minimum of two PubMed indexed research publications. One year experience in Health Research. Certification in data management/experience in statistical software - STATA/R/SPSS/RedCap Minimum of two publications. The age limit is 40 Years as on 01.12.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The monthly emoluments are Rs. 1,20,000/- (Consolidated). The appointment is Temporary (Purely on contract) for a period till 30.09.2027 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST POST DOCTORAL FELLOW (MEDICAL) (TEMPORARY) Job Description
content_sections.text: Research co-ordination and project management. Data management, analysis and reporting. Preparation of manuscripts and scientific presentations.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Original certificates to prove age, qualification and experience Copies of certificates to prove age, qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 09:30 am on 4 December 2026 at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS building, and the interview is scheduled for 10:30 am. The mode of selection is a walk-in interview. Depending on the number of candidates, a written test of qualifying nature will be conducted for initial screening. Only candidates who qualify in the written test will be called for interview. Marks obtained in the written test, if conducted, will not be counted for final ranking.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The post is purely on contract and lasts till 30.09.2027 or till completion of project P-5393, whichever is earlier. The notice is published on the institute website, www.sctimst.ac.in , and on the notice boards of the Hospital, AMCHSS and BMT Wing.

faq.question: Q1. When is the SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 at 10:30 am, and candidates must report at 09:30 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the SCTIMST walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The interview is at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS Building, Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 existing vacancy of Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) (Temporary).

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MD in Community Medicine, Ophthalmology or General Medicine, a minimum of two PubMed indexed research publications and one year of experience in Health Research.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 Years as on 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical)?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 1,20,000/- (Consolidated).

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your Bio-data, original certificates and copies of certificates to prove age, qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through a walk-in interview; depending on the number of candidates, a qualifying written test may be held first for screening, and its marks will not count for final ranking.

faq.question: Q9. Is the SCTIMST Post Doctoral Fellow (Medical) post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is Temporary (Purely on contract) till 30.09.2027 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Which skills are desirable for this post?
faq.answer: Certification in data management or experience in statistical software (STATA/R/SPSS/RedCap) and a minimum of two publications are listed as desirable.
